title: Sunshine Pictures IPO Details
intro:
Sunshine Pictures IPO is a book build issue of ₹282.14 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.48 crore shares aggregating to ₹172.80 crores and offer for sale of 0.30 crore shares aggregating to ₹109.34 crores.

Sunshine Pictures IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 18, 2026 and will close on Aug 20, 2026. The allotment for the Sunshine Pictures IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 21, 2026. Sunshine Pictures IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 25, 2026.

Sunshine Pictures IPO is set issue price band at ₹342 to ₹360 per share. The lot size for an application is 41 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,760 (41 shares) (based on upper price).

GYR Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Sunshine Pictures IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2007, Sunshine Pictures Limited is a production company engaged in the business of originating, creating, developing, producing, marketing, and distributing films, TV serials, and web series.

The company is a technology-driven content creator specializing in innovative commercial films, covering script development, production, intellectual property creation, rights monetization, and distribution.
The company has produced notable films like ‘Force’, ‘Commando’, ‘Holiday’, ‘Force 2’, ‘Commando 2’, and ‘The Kerala Story’, achieving commercial success and addressing social relevance.

The company has produced ten commercial films (six co-produced), two web series, two TV serials, and one short film. It is currently co-producing two films with Jio Studios and producing one web series for Doordarshan.

The company produces projects either as a sole producer or co-producer with reputable studios. It maintains a mix of co-produced and standalone projects, balancing risk and revenue potential, particularly for high-budget productions.

The company is active on social media platforms like YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook. It has 162,960 YouTube subscribers, 9.18 crore views, and 104,500 followers across Instagram and Facebook, generating additional revenue from content streaming.
As of June 30, 2026, the company has a total strength of 28 full-time employees.
strengths: Experienced Promoters supported by Senior Management team
Established Track Record and long-standing relationships in the industry

faqs.question: How to apply in Sunshine Pictures IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sunshine Pictures IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sunshine Pictures IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sunshine Pictures IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sunshine Pictures IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Sunshine Pictures IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Sunshine Pictures IPO opens on Tue, Aug 18, 2026 and closes on Thu, Aug 20, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Sunshine Pictures IPO?
faqs.answer: Sunshine Pictures IPO lot size is 41 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,760 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Sunshine Pictures IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Sunshine Pictures IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Sunshine Pictures IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Sunshine Pictures IPO will be done on Friday, August 21, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Aug 24, 2026 . Check the Sunshine Pictures IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Sunshine Pictures IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Sunshine Pictures IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Aug 25, 2026 .
